# Megan Warren

> Megan Warren (Educator and Creative) is a former high school math teacher
> in Boston, Massachusetts, who works remotely. She writes training manuals, onboarding
> guides, how-to guides, and study guides, builds custom web tools, and builds
> Canvas course pages. She is not
> the interior designer, the executive coach, or the wellness coach of the
> same name; this site is megan-warren.com.

## What she makes

1. Training manuals, onboarding guides, how-to guides, certification and study
   guides, course textbooks, and training decks. Each is built the way her
   seven free books are: steps in order, worked examples, hints where readers
   get stuck, a print menu, and a read-aloud button. Clients own the files and
   the source code.
2. Custom web tools for one job a team does by hand. Examples: free
   fundraising calculators on asktheturtle.com/tools, and Prospect Finder, a
   private, login-gated tool that turns a nonprofit's name into a spreadsheet
   of contacts drawn from its IRS Form 990 filings.
3. Canvas unit hubs and before-class prep pages, built from a course's
   existing materials, such as its book and lesson slides.

Every project is quoted at a fixed price, by scope, before work starts.
